# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

- (cand_0002) Feedback text misleads: 183-8 says "answer cells hold FORMULAS" although the agent wrote none (they were input formulas wiped on save), and TYPE tallies count str-vs-float cells that the real comparator accepts (188-39). Both steer edits wrong. Also, cand_0001's JOURNAL entry was empty; enforce that the optimizer writes one.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

- (cand_0003) Give the proposer a ready-made `golden_diff <task>` tool (init value / init formula / golden value / agent output per graded cell). I rebuilt it by hand every iteration, and it was the single most useful diagnostic. Also, the 45707 feedback ("1 cell CHANGED although the expected value is the cell's own original input") was the key hint; this per-cell classification is valuable and should be extended to "your value for an already-filled cell differs from it".
